text:
No contract has been formed yet. The catalog was an invitation to deal, Marty's purchase order was the offer, and Costco's confirmation, which is expressly conditional on a $50-per-thousand loading charge, is a counteroffer under UCC § 2-207(1) that Rainmaking has not accepted. Any contract would have to arise later from the parties' conduct under § 2-207(3), and the loading charge would not be part of it.

CONFIDENCE: 70
